panels.description: Procedure volume and lifecycle health for the selected events and object filters.
panels.title: Overview

panels.description: Number of distinct procedures in the selected time range and filters; this is not the raw event-row count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT procedure_id) AS procedures FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}'

panels.title: Procedures

panels.description: Distinct procedures that emitted a Succeeded lifecycle trigger in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN procedure_id END) AS succeeded FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}'

panels.title: Succeeded

panels.description: Distinct procedures that emitted Failed or Poisoned. A non-zero value is a terminal failure signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN procedure_id END) AS failed_or_poisoned FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}'

panels.title: Failed / Poisoned

panels.description: Procedures with Submitted but no Succeeded, Failed, or Poisoned lifecycle event after 15 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_running FROM (SELECT procedure_id FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY procedure_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 END) = 0 AND MIN(timestamp) < current_timestamp - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE) AS in_flight

panels.title: In-flight > 15m

panels.description: Time-series procedure activity and terminal outcomes by event type.
panels.title: Lifecycle

panels.description: Five-minute procedure activity by event type. Each series counts distinct procedure_id values, not duplicated topology or locator rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5' MINUTE, timestamp) AS time, type AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT procedure_id) AS value FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: Procedure activity by type

panels.description: Terminal success, failure or poison, and retry counts by event type. Retry is diagnostic and not a terminal outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN procedure_id END) AS succeeded, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN procedure_id END) AS failed_or_poisoned, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Retrying\"') THEN procedure_id END) AS retried FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY type ORDER BY type

panels.title: Terminal outcomes by type

panels.description: Failed, poisoned, and long-running procedure investigations.
panels.title: Investigation

panels.description: Terminal Failed or Poisoned lifecycle rows. Object locator columns can be null on lightweight terminal events; payload preserves submitted intent when available.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(timestamp AS STRING) AS event_time, type, procedure_id, procedure_state, json_get_string(procedure_trigger, 'type') AS trigger, catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, table_id, region_id, procedure_error, payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"')) AND type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Failed or poisoned procedures

panels.description: Procedures with no terminal lifecycle event 15 minutes after submission. Grouping is by procedure_id, so multi-row events appear once.

targets.rawSql: SELECT type, procedure_id, CAST(MIN(timestamp) AS STRING) AS submitted_at, CAST(MAX(timestamp) AS STRING) AS latest_event_at, MAX(procedure_state) AS latest_state, MAX(catalog_name) AS catalog_name, MAX(schema_name) AS schema_name, MAX(table_name) AS table_name, MAX(table_id) AS table_id, MAX(region_id) AS region_id FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN (${event_type:sqlstring}) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY type, procedure_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 END) = 0 AND MIN(timestamp) < current_timestamp - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE ORDER BY submitted_at LIMIT 200

panels.title: Long-running procedures (> 15m)

panels.description: Procedure-level database and table DDL executions, including lifecycle outcome, retry count, and Submitted-time object context.
panels.title: DDL Operations

panels.description: One complete Database DDL execution per procedure. The row combines submission, retries, and terminal outcome; an execution with Submitted but no terminal event is In-flight.

targets.rawSql: WITH lifecycle AS (SELECT type, procedure_id, MIN(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') THEN timestamp END) AS submitted_time, MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_time, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN timestamp END) AS terminal_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Retrying\"') THEN timestamp END) AS retry_count, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poisoned, MAX(procedure_error) AS procedure_error FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN ('create_database', 'alter_database', 'drop_database') GROUP BY type, procedure_id), submitted_context AS (SELECT type, procedure_id, MAX(catalog_name) AS catalog_name, MAX(schema_name) AS schema_name, MAX(json_to_string(payload)) AS submitted_payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN ('create_database', 'alter_database', 'drop_database') AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY type, procedure_id) SELECT l.type, l.procedure_id, CAST(l.submitted_time AS STRING) AS start_time, CAST(l.terminal_time AS STRING) AS end_time, CAST(l.last_event_time AS STRING) AS last_seen_time, CASE WHEN l.poisoned = 1 THEN 'Poisoned' WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS outcome, l.retry_count, l.procedure_error, s.catalog_name, s.schema_name, s.submitted_payload FROM lifecycle l JOIN submitted_context s ON s.type = l.type AND s.procedure_id = l.procedure_id ORDER BY l.submitted_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Database DDL executions

panels.description: One complete Table DDL execution per procedure. Multiple table locators are collapsed into affected_table_count, so logical-table batch operations do not duplicate executions.

targets.rawSql: WITH lifecycle AS (SELECT type, procedure_id, MIN(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') THEN timestamp END) AS submitted_time, MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_time, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN timestamp END) AS terminal_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Retrying\"') THEN timestamp END) AS retry_count, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poisoned, MAX(procedure_error) AS procedure_error FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN ('create_table', 'create_logical_tables', 'alter_table', 'alter_logical_tables', 'drop_table', 'undrop_table', 'purge_dropped_table', 'truncate_table') GROUP BY type, procedure_id), submitted_context AS (SELECT type, procedure_id, MAX(catalog_name) AS catalog_name, MAX(schema_name) AS schema_name, COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) AS affected_table_count, MAX(json_to_string(payload)) AS submitted_payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN ('create_table', 'create_logical_tables', 'alter_table', 'alter_logical_tables', 'drop_table', 'undrop_table', 'purge_dropped_table', 'truncate_table') AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY type, procedure_id) SELECT l.type, l.procedure_id, CAST(l.submitted_time AS STRING) AS start_time, CAST(l.terminal_time AS STRING) AS end_time, CAST(l.last_event_time AS STRING) AS last_seen_time, CASE WHEN l.poisoned = 1 THEN 'Poisoned' WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS outcome, l.retry_count, l.procedure_error, s.catalog_name, s.schema_name, s.affected_table_count, s.submitted_payload FROM lifecycle l JOIN submitted_context s ON s.type = l.type AND s.procedure_id = l.procedure_id ORDER BY l.submitted_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Table DDL executions

panels.description: Report-only Batch GC records by region. Batch GC does not guarantee a Submitted event, so these rows never contribute to the In-flight lifecycle count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(timestamp AS STRING) AS event_time, procedure_id, procedure_state, json_get_string(procedure_trigger, 'type') AS trigger, region_id, table_id, region_number, procedure_error, json_to_string(payload) AS payload, json_to_string(gc_report) AS gc_report FROM greptime_private.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND type = 'batch_gc' AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Batch GC reports

panels.description: One complete execution row for each Repartition root or group. Group rows are linked to roots from Submitted metadata and retain their own lifecycle outcome without duplicating topology mappings.

targets.rawSql: WITH root_lifecycle AS (SELECT procedure_id, MIN(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') THEN timestamp END) AS root_submitted_time, MAX(timestamp) AS root_last_event_time, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN timestamp END) AS root_terminal_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Retrying\"') THEN timestamp END) AS retry_count, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poisoned, MAX(procedure_error) AS procedure_error FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'repartition' GROUP BY procedure_id), root_context AS (SELECT procedure_id, MAX(catalog_name) AS catalog_name, MAX(schema_name) AS schema_name, MAX(table_name) AS table_name, MAX(table_id) AS table_id, MAX(json_to_string(payload)) AS submitted_payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'repartition' AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND ('${table:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(table_name, '(none)') IN (${table:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY procedure_id), group_lifecycle AS (SELECT procedure_id, MIN(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') THEN timestamp END) AS group_submitted_time, MAX(timestamp) AS group_last_event_time, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN timestamp END) AS group_terminal_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Retrying\"') THEN timestamp END) AS retry_count, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poisoned, MAX(procedure_error) AS procedure_error FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'repartition_group' GROUP BY procedure_id), group_context AS (SELECT parent_procedure_id, procedure_id AS group_procedure_id, repartition_group_id, MAX(catalog_name) AS catalog_name, MAX(schema_name) AS schema_name, MAX(table_name) AS table_name, MAX(table_id) AS table_id, MAX(json_to_string(payload)) AS submitted_payload, COUNT(*) AS topology_mapping_count FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'repartition_group' AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY parent_procedure_id, procedure_id, repartition_group_id), group_parent_summary AS (SELECT c.parent_procedure_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.group_procedure_id) AS child_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN c.group_procedure_id END) AS succeeded_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.failed = 1 OR l.poisoned = 1 THEN c.group_procedure_id END) AS failed_group_count FROM group_context c LEFT JOIN group_lifecycle l ON l.procedure_id = c.group_procedure_id GROUP BY c.parent_procedure_id) SELECT 'Root' AS execution_level, l.procedure_id AS root_procedure_id, l.procedure_id AS procedure_id, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS repartition_group_id, CAST(l.root_submitted_time AS STRING) AS start_time, CAST(l.root_terminal_time AS STRING) AS end_time, CAST(l.root_last_event_time AS STRING) AS last_seen_time, CASE WHEN l.poisoned = 1 THEN 'Poisoned' WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS outcome, l.retry_count, l.procedure_error, c.catalog_name, c.schema_name, c.table_name, c.table_id, c.submitted_payload, COALESCE(p.child_group_count, 0) AS child_group_count, COALESCE(p.succeeded_group_count, 0) AS succeeded_group_count, COALESCE(p.failed_group_count, 0) AS failed_group_count, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS topology_mapping_count FROM root_lifecycle l JOIN root_context c ON c.procedure_id = l.procedure_id LEFT JOIN group_parent_summary p ON p.parent_procedure_id = l.procedure_id WHERE COALESCE(l.procedure_id, '') LIKE '${repartition_parent_id}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Group' AS execution_level, c.parent_procedure_id AS root_procedure_id, l.procedure_id AS procedure_id, c.repartition_group_id, CAST(l.group_submitted_time AS STRING) AS start_time, CAST(l.group_terminal_time AS STRING) AS end_time, CAST(l.group_last_event_time AS STRING) AS last_seen_time, CASE WHEN l.poisoned = 1 THEN 'Poisoned' WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS outcome, l.retry_count, l.procedure_error, c.catalog_name, c.schema_name, c.table_name, c.table_id, c.submitted_payload, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS child_group_count, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS succeeded_group_count, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS failed_group_count, c.topology_mapping_count FROM group_lifecycle l JOIN group_context c ON c.group_procedure_id = l.procedure_id WHERE COALESCE(c.parent_procedure_id, '') LIKE '${repartition_parent_id}' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Repartition executions

panels.description: One source-to-target region mapping per Repartition group. The group outcome is joined by child procedure ID, while root procedure ID provides the parent execution context.

targets.rawSql: WITH group_submitted AS (SELECT parent_procedure_id, procedure_id AS group_procedure_id, repartition_group_id, table_id, timestamp AS group_submitted_time, source_region_id, source_region_number, source_partition_expr, target_region_id, target_region_number, target_partition_expr FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'repartition_group' AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Submitted\"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)), group_lifecycle AS (SELECT procedure_id, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Succeeded\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Failed\"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == \"Poisoned\"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'repartition_group' GROUP BY procedure_id) SELECT CAST(s.group_submitted_time AS STRING) AS event_time, s.parent_procedure_id AS root_procedure_id, s.group_procedure_id, s.repartition_group_id, s.table_id, CASE WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS group_outcome, s.source_region_id, s.source_region_number, s.source_partition_expr, s.target_region_id, s.target_region_number, s.target_partition_expr FROM group_submitted s LEFT JOIN group_lifecycle l ON l.procedure_id = s.group_procedure_id WHERE COALESCE(s.parent_procedure_id, '') LIKE '${repartition_parent_id}' ORDER BY s.group_submitted_time DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Repartition topology

panels.description: All recorded fields for the selected procedure, ordered by event timestamp. Use this trace to inspect Submitted, Retrying, RollingBack, ChildSubmitted, and terminal events behind a summary row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(timestamp AS STRING) AS timestamp, type, json_to_string(payload) AS payload, procedure_id, procedure_state, procedure_error, json_to_string(procedure_trigger) AS procedure_trigger, catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, table_id, physical_table_id, region_id, region_number, region_migration_trigger_reason, region_migration_src_node_id, region_migration_src_peer_addr, region_migration_dst_node_id, region_migration_dst_peer_addr, topic_name, prunable_entry_id, latest_offset, json_to_string(gc_report) AS gc_report, parent_procedure_id, repartition_group_id, source_region_id, source_region_number, source_partition_expr, target_region_id, target_region_number, target_partition_expr FROM greptime_private.events WHERE COALESCE(procedure_id, '') = '${trace_procedure_id}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

panels.title: Procedure lifecycle trace

panels.description: Batch GC reports and WAL prune records. These maintenance event types have intentionally sparse lifecycle emission.
panels.title: Maintenance Operations

panels.description: Repartition and Region Migration executions, including child-group topology where applicable.
panels.title: Region Operations

panels.description: Raw recorded fields for one selected procedure, used to inspect every stored lifecycle transition.
panels.title: Procedure Trace

panels.description: Each persisted WAL Prune transition, including topic and requested prune boundary. latest_offset is the optional observed exclusive upper bound, not a deleted-record count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(timestamp AS STRING) AS event_time, topic_name, prunable_entry_id, latest_offset, procedure_id, procedure_state, json_get_string(procedure_trigger, 'type') AS trigger, procedure_error, json_to_string(payload) AS payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'wal_prune' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: WAL prune records

panels.description: One complete Region Migration execution per procedure, including affected scope, trigger reason, and source and destination datanode identities.

targets.rawSql: WITH lifecycle AS (SELECT procedure_id, MIN(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Submitted"') THEN timestamp END) AS submitted_time, MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_time, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Succeeded"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Failed"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Poisoned"') THEN timestamp END) AS terminal_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Retrying"') THEN timestamp END) AS retry_count, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Succeeded"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Failed"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Poisoned"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poisoned, MAX(procedure_error) AS procedure_error FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'region_migration' GROUP BY procedure_id), migration_context AS (SELECT procedure_id, COUNT(DISTINCT table_id) AS affected_table_count, COUNT(DISTINCT region_id) AS affected_region_count, MAX(region_migration_trigger_reason) AS trigger_reason, MAX(region_migration_src_node_id) AS from_datanode_id, MAX(region_migration_src_peer_addr) AS from_datanode_addr, MAX(region_migration_dst_node_id) AS to_datanode_id, MAX(region_migration_dst_peer_addr) AS to_datanode_addr, MAX(json_to_string(payload)) AS submitted_payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type = 'region_migration' AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Submitted"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY procedure_id) SELECT l.procedure_id, CAST(l.submitted_time AS STRING) AS start_time, CAST(l.terminal_time AS STRING) AS end_time, CAST(l.last_event_time AS STRING) AS last_seen_time, CASE WHEN l.poisoned = 1 THEN 'Poisoned' WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS outcome, l.retry_count, l.procedure_error, c.affected_table_count, c.affected_region_count, c.trigger_reason, c.from_datanode_id, c.from_datanode_addr, c.to_datanode_id, c.to_datanode_addr, c.submitted_payload FROM lifecycle l JOIN migration_context c ON c.procedure_id = l.procedure_id ORDER BY l.submitted_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: One complete Flow or View DDL execution per procedure. The row combines submission, retries, and terminal outcome; submitted payload preserves object intent.

targets.rawSql: WITH lifecycle AS (SELECT type, procedure_id, MIN(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Submitted"') THEN timestamp END) AS submitted_time, MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_time, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Succeeded"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Failed"') OR json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Poisoned"') THEN timestamp END) AS terminal_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Retrying"') THEN timestamp END) AS retry_count, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Succeeded"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Failed"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, MAX(CASE WHEN json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Poisoned"') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poisoned, MAX(procedure_error) AS procedure_error FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN ('create_flow', 'drop_flow', 'create_view', 'drop_view') GROUP BY type, procedure_id), submitted_context AS (SELECT type, procedure_id, MAX(catalog_name) AS catalog_name, MAX(schema_name) AS schema_name, MAX(json_to_string(payload)) AS submitted_payload FROM greptime_private.events WHERE type IN ('create_flow', 'drop_flow', 'create_view', 'drop_view') AND json_path_match(procedure_trigger, '$.type == "Submitted"') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${catalog:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(catalog_name, '(none)') IN (${catalog:sqlstring})) AND ('${schema:raw}' = '$__all' OR COALESCE(schema_name, '(none)') IN (${schema:sqlstring})) AND COALESCE(procedure_id, '') LIKE '${procedure_id}' GROUP BY type, procedure_id) SELECT l.type, l.procedure_id, CAST(l.submitted_time AS STRING) AS start_time, CAST(l.terminal_time AS STRING) AS end_time, CAST(l.last_event_time AS STRING) AS last_seen_time, CASE WHEN l.poisoned = 1 THEN 'Poisoned' WHEN l.failed = 1 THEN 'Failed' WHEN l.succeeded = 1 THEN 'Succeeded' ELSE 'In-flight' END AS outcome, l.retry_count, l.procedure_error, s.catalog_name, s.schema_name, s.submitted_payload FROM lifecycle l JOIN submitted_context s ON s.type = l.type AND s.procedure_id = l.procedure_id ORDER BY l.submitted_time DESC LIMIT 200
